scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && tsc --noEmit -p packages/uredu && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ship-safely && tsc --noEmit -p packages/game && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ui && tsc --noEmit -p packages/binary
scripts.test:types: tsc --noEmit -p packages/uredu/test/types && bun run --cwd examples/mixed check && bun scripts/check-readme.ts
scripts.build:types: bun run --cwd packages/uredu build:types && bun run --cwd packages/ship-safely build:types && bun run --cwd packages/game build:types && bun run --cwd packages/ui build:types
scripts.publish:npm: bun run build:types && for p in uredu ship-safely game ui; do (cd packages/$p && bun publish) || exit 1; done
